WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    sf.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader AS t
    ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind
),
with_deviation AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    tradekind,
    avg_optvolrt,
    ABS(avg_optvolrt - overall.avg_optvolrt) AS deviation
  FROM pair_averages
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  ) AS overall
  WHERE overall.avg_optvolrt IS NOT NULL
),
with_type_average AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation
  FROM with_deviation
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
),
selected_pairs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM with_type_average
  WHERE deviation > type_avg_deviation
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio,
  AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
  AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess
FROM selected_pairs
GROUP BY tradekind;
